author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Front-loading washer: upright box, control-panel slot top-left, knob dot top-right, large r7 porthole centred below; no longer reads as a face. Lucide washing-machine construction (box, panel marks, round door).
omissions: The reference's divider line under the control panel is omitted (panel marks, divider and door cannot all keep 8-unit spacing in 40 units of height); corners are square on the centerline with round-join ink corners so the marks certify at exactly 8 from the walls.
